entities.name: Sin-Eribam
entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Sin-Eribam ruled the ancient Near East Amorite city-state of Larsa for only 2 years, from c. 1843 BC to c. 1841 BC (MC). He
followed Sin-Iddinam as king. He was the son of the son of Ga’eš-rabi.
